info.title: Nawy marketplace API
info.description: Generated from the Laravel routes (`php artisan nawy:openapi`). Every answer uses the envelope {data, meta}; every error {error: {code, message, fields}}.

bearer.description: Sanctum token from a sign-in endpoint (customer, delivery or ops scope).

idempotencyKey.name: Idempotency-Key
idempotencyKey.description: Retry-safe key: the same key returns the first answer (header Idempotent-Replayed: true).
